## 中文原文
周末下午，你打算带宝宝去楼下公园晒晒太阳。你装好尿不湿、湿巾和小毯子放进推车。刚出门没多久，天突然阴下来，刮起一阵风，你担心下雨，只好推着宝宝折返回家。

## My translation
On this weekend afternoon, I planned to take my baby to enjoy the sunshine at the park downstairs.
I packed diapers, tissue paper and a small blanket into the cart.
After we stepped out of the door, it started to be cloudy and windy.
I was worried about raining, so I had to take my baby back home.

## Revised version
This weekend afternoon, I planned to take my baby down to the park to get some sunshine.
I packed diapers, tissues and a small blanket into the stroller.
Right after we stepped out the door, it turned cloudy and windy.
I was worried it would rain, so I had to bring my baby back home.

## Key phrases
- tissues，湿巾
- stroller，推车
